# Fixture manifest.
#
# Format (colon-separated, 2 fields):
#   <base_name>:<description>
#
# base_name   - shared stem of <base_name>.in / <base_name>.out in this
#               directory. Must be <= 8 characters - see tests/README.md
#               ("Filename length constraint") for why.
# description - short human-readable summary of what the fixture exercises
#               (may contain colons).
#
# Every .in in this directory must be listed here; tests/run_tests.sh fails
# otherwise.

test1:3-trait discrete 1-stage selection, FS/HS groups, common environmental effects (ported from the original SelAction distribution's smoke test)
test2s:3-trait discrete 2-stage selection (sel2s), own performance in stage 1 then added BLUP breeding values in stage 2, no FS/HS/progeny groups, same genetic parameters as test1
test3s:3-trait discrete 3-stage selection (sel3s), own performance in stage 1, BLUP breeding values added in stage 2, FS+HS group information added in stage 3, same genetic parameters and FS/HS group sizes as test1
blup1:3-trait discrete 1-stage selection (sel1s) isolating the BLUP-specific branch of the inbreeding calculation (dFmtblup/hyper_correct in selroutines.f90): all 3 traits use only BLUP breeding values (code 2) plus the half-sib group (code 24) as information sources, terminated by -1 - no own performance or full-sib info, unlike test1's mixed source list; same genetic parameters and HS group size as test1
advgrp:3-trait discrete 1-stage selection (sel1s) adversarial coverage for the unconfigured-group-type matrix-block guards in selection_index (selroutines.f90): full-sib groups left fully unconfigured (fsgroups=0) while half-sib (1 group, code 24) AND progeny groups (1 group, code 64) are both configured and actually selected as info sources - the progeny-group path (matp's i+63 block) was previously untested by any fixture; also zeroes the ADG-FCR common environmental correlation to exercise a legitimately-zero numerator term inside the group-block formulas
ovlp2:2-trait overlapping generations (ovlp in selovlp.f90), 2 age classes per sex (4 effective classes), truncation selection, own performance only as info source in every age class, no fs/hs/progeny groups, common environment disabled - first regression fixture for the overlapping-generations code path; also the fixture that surfaced and pinned down the ccprog uninitialized-read fix (see tests/README.md)
ovlpgrp:2-trait overlapping generations, 2 age classes per sex, truncation selection, common environment enabled, all three group types configured and selected as info sources (1 full-sib, 1 half-sib, 1 progeny group, each paired with own performance) in every age class - exercises info_sourcesovlp's group-code branches and ovlp_cov_update's fs/hs covariance terms, previously untested by any fixture; expected output regenerated after the ovlp truncation threshold-search fix (see tests/README.md)
noce1:test1 with common environmental effects switched off (discrete 1-stage): the c-square and common-environmental correlation questions are skipped, so the unset-ccorr path fixed on 2026-10-09 is pinned in discrete generations too
goalonly:test1 with FCR as a goal-only trait (use h, no information sources; genetic correlation -0.5 with ADG): economic value of a goal-only trait and response of a trait not in the index
onetrait:a single trait (ADG) in discrete 1-stage selection: no trait-use question (set to b), no correlations; own performance, full-sib and half-sib groups
fivetr:5 traits in discrete 1-stage selection (i, b, b, b, h), positive definite correlations: larger matrices; the goal-only trait has non-zero genetic correlations so no warning
multigrp:discrete 1-stage selection with two groups of each type (2 full-sib, 2 half-sib, 2 progeny groups of different sizes) used by different traits, common environment with progeny-test c-square
matrat1:[pending Q6] test1 with sires = dams = 10 (mating ratio 1): note_matrat warns and the half-sib sources (including the BLUP half-sib terms) are dropped
sires19:[pending Q7] the Question 7 example: test1 traits, 19 sires, 50 dams, 5 male and 20 female candidates per dam, p dams 0.05, p sires 19/250 (half-sib group kept at 200 dams as in the letter's figure); predicted inbreeding 4.590% per generation, below the 20-sire switch in dFmtblup
sires20:[pending Q7] as sires19 with 20 sires (p sires 20/250): predicted inbreeding 4.682% per generation, above the 20-sire switch
sxd1:separate indices for sires and dams in discrete 1-stage selection (traitinfo2): sires use own performance, full-sib and half-sib groups for all 3 traits; dams use own performance for eADG and ADG only (FCR not in the dam index); prints the dam index
sxd2:separate indices in discrete 2-stage selection: FCR goal-only in stage 1 and added to both the sire and the dam index in stage 2 (traitinfo3, traitinfo4); sires add FS/HS groups in stage 2, dams add BLUP
sxd3:separate indices in discrete 3-stage selection: FCR goal-only in stages 1-2 and added to both indices in stage 3 (traitinfo5, traitinfo6); BLUP in stage 2, groups in stage 3; one dam trait adds nothing in stage 3
prog2s:discrete 2-stage selection with full-sib, half-sib and progeny groups and common environment (progeny-test c-square, the 2-stage copy of that question): own performance + FS + HS in stage 1, progeny group added in stage 2; FCR goal-only in stage 1 and added to the index in stage 2 (traitinfo3)
prog3s:discrete 3-stage selection with the same groups as prog2s: own performance in stage 1, FS + HS in stage 2, progeny in stage 3; FCR added to the index in stage 3 (traitinfo5); same overall proportions selected as prog2s, so the final-stage results agree with it
onetrt2s:a single trait in discrete 2-stage selection: no trait-use questions in either stage; own performance in stage 1, BLUP + FS + HS added in stage 2
nophen1:the no-phenotypic-information warning (note_pheninfo) and all its corrections in discrete 1-stage selection with separate sire/dam indices: two goal-only traits with zero genetic correlations answered c (new correlation with a trait listed after, then before), and a BLUP-only sire-index trait answered i, s (sire sources entered again)
nophen1n:as nophen1 with one index for sires and dams: the two correlation corrections and the i answer without the sire/dam question
nophen2:the warning and its corrections in discrete 2-stage selection with separate indices; the BLUP-only trait is in the dam index and is answered i, d (dam sources entered again for stages 1 and 2)
nophen2n:as nophen2 with one index (2-stage)
nophen3:the warning and its corrections in discrete 3-stage selection with separate indices; the BLUP-only sire-index trait is answered i, s (sources entered again for stages 1-3)
nophen3n:as nophen3 with one index (3-stage)
